# DCX Marketing Solutions

DCX Marketing Solutions (also known as DCX Solutions) is a full-stack digital and marketing agency. The company provides website development, application development (Android, iOS and web), digital marketing and SEO, Google Ads management, brand building, social media management, video editing, public relations and business consultancy. It is led by Co-Founder & CEO Ayushi Sethi and works with businesses of every size, from schools and clinics to tourism operators and startups, across India.

## Services
- Website Development — high-performance, conversion-focused websites and web platforms
- Application Development — Android, iOS and web applications
- Digital Marketing & SEO — search optimisation, Google Ads and AI-driven campaigns
- Brand Building — identity, voice and strategy
- Social Media Management — Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, X and LinkedIn management
- Video Editing — reels, brand films and motion content
- Public Relations — media coverage, press releases and reputation management
- Business Consultancy — growth strategy for small businesses and startups
